{{Top}}
[[File:SatePestage-NEGTC.png|250px|thumb|Grand Vizier [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]]]]
The '''Grand Vizier''' was the head of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] and chief deputy to the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Acting as an intermediary between the Emperor and high-ranking officials in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] as well as the [[Politics/Legends|government]], the office of Grand [[Vizier/Legends|Vizier]] was established in the aftermath of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] into the Empire. The Grand Vizier was also the [[President of the Senate|President]] of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] and the custodian of the [[Imperial Seal/Legends|Imperial Seal]].

==History==
The position of Grand Vizier was formed after the establishment of the Empire, and may have been a replacement for two pre-existing offices, those of [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] and [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]]. The only individual to serve in the office was [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]]. As head of the Imperial Government, Pestage was not only a very powerful bureaucrat, he was a loyal and trusted servant to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

{{Imp-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In a cut scene from [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], Sate Pestage was intended to have an appearance as a hologram warning Darth Vader of the Emperor's imminent transmission. He was referred to as the "Grand Vizier."<ref name="SWAS">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref> Hints of this scene can be found on the box for [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] "Darth Vader's Star Destroyer" playset, explaining that the image in the red plastic viewing screen is the Grand Vizier.<ref name="SWPlaysets">{{SW|url=news/from-icy-trenches-to-ewok-campfires-kenner-playsets-part-2|text=Kenner's ''Star Wars'' Playsets, Part 2: From Icy Trenches to Ewok Campfires|nolive=1}}</ref>
